eeo: Equal employment opportunity: never filter, rank, or describe candidates by age, sex or gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, disability, pregnancy, marital status, or sexual orientation. Evaluate only job-related skills and experience.
screening: Screening questions must be job-related and asked consistently of every candidate. Do not ask about protected characteristics, family plans, or health.
data_privacy: Candidate contact details are personal data. The assistant must not reveal email addresses, phone numbers, or government IDs; recruiters retrieve them from the ATS directly.
ai_use: Match scores are decision support only. A human recruiter makes every advance or reject decision and can override any score.
